import json
from qb.kth import kth

CASES = [[[[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], 4], 5], [[[3, 6, 7, 1, 6, 3, 8, 9], 5], 7], [[[3, 6, 7, 1, 6, 3, 8, 9], 2], 3], [[[2, 6, 8, 3, 5, 7], 0], 2], [[[34, 25, 7, 1, 9], 4], 34]]


def check():
    for input_data, expected in CASES:
        got = kth(*input_data)
        assert json.loads(json.dumps(got, default=list)) == expected, "kth(%r) returned %r, expected %r" % (input_data, got, expected)
